subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Who should provide the required live Discord conflict-to-success proof before this PR merges?
rationale: The contributor states they lack Crabbox and Discord credentials, while repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof that mocked tests and CI cannot supply.

options.title: Maintainer runs Discord proof
options.body: A maintainer uses the Discord live transport or QA Lab lane to capture redacted exact-once recovery evidence after the code finding is fixed.

options.title: Contributor supplies external proof
options.body: The contributor runs an accessible real Discord setup and attaches redacted logs, live output, or a recording showing conflict recovery.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the focused tests and CI without live transport evidence.

recommendation.title: Maintainer runs Discord proof
recommendation.body: A maintainer uses the Discord live transport or QA Lab lane to capture redacted exact-once recovery evidence after the code finding is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent central-path history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate for deciding or arranging Discord runtime proof.
